# MONEVA - the landing page for the Android app.
#
# Without this file Cloudflare serves a generated one: the Content Signals
# Policy preamble. That text is comments only - it declares no rule in either
# direction - so nothing is given up by replacing it, and this adds the two
# things a generated file cannot know: what to skip, and where the sitemap is.
#
# It deliberately does NOT declare AI content signals. Cloudflare's default
# declared none either, and whether to allow ai-train / ai-input is a decision
# about this content, not a technical default to inherit.

User-agent: *
Allow: /

# The APK is for people, not crawlers. Indexing a 2.8 MB binary spends crawl
# budget on something no search result should ever be, and can surface a bare
# download link with no page around it to explain what is being installed.
Disallow: /downloads/

Sitemap: https://moneva.monev.workers.dev/sitemap.xml
